title: UI overhaul foundation: shadcn neutral theme, app shell and composer
description: User-requested overhaul into a chat-centred shadcn workspace (ChatGPT/Claude/Elicit class). Foundation owned by the lead: neutral tokens, light/dark, Geist, collapsible sidebar shell, command palette, unified composer, model switcher, query layer and test helpers.
acceptance_criteria: Given a first visit, when the system prefers dark, then the app renders shadcn neutral dark tokens without a light flash, and the theme toggle switches Light/Dark/System persistently.
Given any route at 1440px, when the user presses Cmd/Ctrl+B, then the sidebar collapses to an icon rail; at 390px the sidebar opens as a sheet and the page has no horizontal overflow.
Given the model switcher, when a model is unavailable, then it is disabled with a reason, and the chosen model and effort are sent with the next generation request.
Given keyboard-only use, then Skip to content is the first tab stop and every control has a visible focus ring.
test_cases: App shell RTL: skip link, Workspace navigation, theme toggle
ModelSwitcher RTL: disabled unavailable model, effort submenu, set as default
npm run check, npm run build main chunk <= 467KB
